Module pad locations, battery leads/contact ratings, RF and final fit remain unmeasured.

full_assembly.method: Decoded GLB mesh buffers/world transforms versus independent CAD, pad and BOM sources

partial_collision_audit.method: Manifold intersections of exported solid GLB shells against assembly STLs; wire end rings capped
limitations: Partial audit: non-solid component surfaces are explicitly skipped, not certified clear.
Only contacts with printed parts are checked; module-to-module and conductor-to-conductor contacts are excluded.
Nominal module dimensions and polyline wire bends are unmeasured; supplier fit and bend radii require physical checks.
